skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand and explain the concept of human resource management, responsibilities, roles of the human resource department, and factors influencing human resource activities in organizations.
Analyze, evaluate, and implement human resource activities, propose solutions to improve human resource management in organizations.
Analyze, evaluate, and implement performance management activities, propose solutions to improve performance management in organizations.
Analyze, evaluate, and implement training and development activities, propose solutions to improve training and development in organizations.
Analyze, evaluate, and implement compensation and benefits activities, propose solutions to improve compensation and benefits in organizations.
Analyze, evaluate, and implement employee motivation activities, propose solutions to improve employee motivation in organizations.
Demonstrate independent and effective teamwork skills.
Demonstrate presentation skills on human resource management issues.
Demonstrate analytical, synthesis, and problem-solving skills related to specific human resource management activities.
